B0001.title: Driver Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control
B0001.plain: The supplemental restraint system (SRS) module has detected a fault in the deployment control circuit for the first stage of the driver frontal airbag. The SRS warning lamp illuminates and airbag deployment may be impaired in a crash event.
causes: Clock spring (spiral cable) damaged in steering column
Loose or corroded airbag connector under steering wheel

B0002.title: Driver Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
B0002.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the deployment control circuit for the second stage of the driver frontal airbag. Dual-stage airbags use two charges for severity-dependent deployment — this code indicates the high-severity stage cannot be triggered reliably.
causes: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

B0003.title: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance Low
B0003.plain: The SRS module has detected that the resistance in the driver frontal airbag deployment loop is below the expected range, suggesting a short or partial short between the squib leads. The airbag warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Shorted squib leads in clock spring or wiring
Internal short within driver airbag module

B0004.title: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance High
B0004.plain: The SRS module measured a higher than expected resistance in the driver frontal airbag deployment circuit. Causes include a partially open connection, corroded contacts, or a damaged clock spring conductor.

B0005.title: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Open
B0005.plain: The SRS module detects an open circuit in the driver frontal airbag deployment loop. The airbag will not deploy in a crash and the SRS warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Wiring harness break in steering column

B0006.title: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Ground
B0006.plain: One of the deployment leads for the driver frontal airbag is shorted to ground. The SRS module disables deployment of the affected stage to prevent unintended firing.
causes: Internal airbag module short to housing

B0007.title: Driver Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Battery
B0007.plain: The driver frontal airbag deployment loop is shorted to battery voltage. This is potentially dangerous as it could cause unintended deployment; the SRS module isolates the circuit and sets the warning lamp.

B0010.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Control
B0010.plain: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Loose or corroded passenger airbag connector

B0011.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
B0011.plain: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

B0012.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
B0012.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the second-stage deployment circuit of the front passenger airbag. The dual-stage charge cannot be triggered as designed and the airbag warning lamp is illuminated.

B0013.title: Passenger Knee Bolster Deployment Control
B0013.plain: Fault on the deployment control circuit of the passenger knee airbag (knee bolster). Restricts lower-body motion of the passenger in a frontal collision.

B0014.title: Driver Knee Airbag Deployment Control
B0014.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the driver knee airbag deployment control circuit. The knee airbag may not deploy in a crash event.

B0015.title: Passenger Knee Airbag Deployment Control
B0015.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the passenger knee airbag deployment control circuit. Same fault profile as B0014 but for the passenger side.

B0016.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Ground
B0016.plain: The SRS module detected a short to ground in the front passenger airbag deployment circuit. Deployment of the affected stage is inhibited and the warning lamp is illuminated.
causes: Water at connector causing low resistance

B0017.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Short to Battery
B0017.plain: The front passenger airbag deployment loop is shorted to battery voltage, creating a risk of unintended deployment. The SRS module disables the circuit and stores this fault.

B0018.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance High
B0018.plain: The SRS module measures a higher than expected resistance in the passenger frontal deployment loop, indicating partial corrosion or damage. The airbag may not deploy reliably.

B0019.title: Right Front/Passenger Frontal Deployment Loop Resistance Low
B0019.plain: The SRS module detects too low a resistance in the front passenger airbag deployment loop, suggesting a partial short. Deployment of that stage is inhibited.

B001A.title: Center Frontal Stage 3 Deployment Control
B001A.plain: Fault on the deployment circuit of the center frontal airbag, deployment stage 3 (highest severity). Used in dual or triple-stage front airbag systems for severe crash energy.

B0020.title: Left Side Deployment Control
B0020.plain: Left Side Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Seat harness connector under driver seat damaged

B0021.title: Left Side Deployment Stage 1 Control
B0021.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the deployment control circuit for the left side (driver) airbag stage 1. Side impact protection on the driver side may be reduced.
causes: Loose airbag connector under driver seat

B0022.title: Left Side Deployment Stage 1 Loop Open
B0022.plain: An open circuit has been detected in the deployment loop for the left side airbag stage 1. The airbag will not fire and the SRS lamp is illuminated.

B0023.title: Left Side Deployment Stage 1 Loop Short to Ground
B0023.plain: The left side airbag stage 1 deployment loop is shorted to ground. Deployment is inhibited and the SRS warning lamp is on.
causes: Chafed wire grounding under seat rail

B0024.title: Right Side Deployment Control
B0024.plain: Right Side Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Seat harness connector under passenger seat damaged

B0025.title: Left Side Deployment Stage 2 Control
B0025.plain: A fault is detected in the deployment control for the second stage of the left side airbag, used in vehicles with two-stage side restraint systems.

B0026.title: Left Side Deployment Stage 2 Loop Open
B0026.plain: An open circuit is present in the second-stage deployment loop of the left side airbag.

B0028.title: Driver Side Curtain Air Bag Deployment Control
B0028.plain: Driver Side Curtain Air Bag Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Curtain airbag squib circuit open or shorted

B0029.title: Right Side Curtain Air Bag Deployment Control
B0029.plain: Right Side Curtain Air Bag Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Curtain airbag squib circuit open or shorted

B002A.title: Right Curtain Deployment Control 2
B002A.plain: Fault on the second deployment circuit of the right side curtain airbag. Curtain airbags deploy along the side glass to protect head and neck in a side or rollover crash.

B0030.title: Driver Side Curtain Airbag Stage 2
B0030.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the driver-side curtain airbag stage 2 deployment circuit. Two-stage curtain airbags use a second charge for severe lateral impacts.
causes: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

B0031.title: Passenger Side Curtain Airbag Stage 2
B0031.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the passenger-side curtain airbag stage 2 deployment circuit. Same fault profile as B0030 but for the passenger side.
causes: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

B0032.title: Right Side Deployment Stage 1 Loop Open
B0032.plain: An open circuit is detected in the right side (passenger) airbag stage 1 deployment loop.
causes: Wire break in passenger seat harness

B0033.title: Right Side Deployment Stage 1 Loop Short to Ground
B0033.plain: The deployment loop for the right side airbag stage 1 is shorted to ground; deployment is inhibited.

B0034.title: Right Side Deployment Stage 2 Control
B0034.plain: The SRS module reports a fault in the deployment circuit of the right side airbag stage 2.

B0036.title: Right Side Deployment Stage 2 Loop Short to Ground
B0036.plain: The right side airbag stage 2 deployment loop is shorted to ground; the SRS module disables that stage.

B0038.title: Second Row Right Side Airbag Deployment Control
B0038.plain: Fault on the deployment circuit of the second-row right-side airbag (built into the seat or door for rear-passenger side-impact protection).

B0039.title: Second Row Right Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control
B0039.plain: Fault on the second-row right frontal airbag, stage 1 deployment (low severity). Found on vehicles with rear-passenger frontal airbags integrated in the front seatbacks.

B003A.title: Second Row Right Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
B003A.plain: Fault on second-row right frontal airbag, stage 2 deployment (medium severity).

B003B.title: Second Row Right Frontal Stage 3 Deployment Control
B003B.plain: Fault on second-row right frontal airbag, stage 3 deployment (high severity).

B0040.title: Outside Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0040.plain: The HVAC or body control module has detected an implausible signal from the outside (ambient) temperature sensor. The displayed outside temperature may be wrong or missing and automatic climate control may behave incorrectly.
causes: Wiring or connector fault to sensor

B0041.title: Third Row Left Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control
B0041.plain: Fault on the third-row left frontal airbag, stage 1 deployment.

B0042.title: Side Deployment Loop Open (Generic)
B0042.plain: A generic open-circuit fault has been reported in a side airbag deployment loop. Refer to vehicle service data to determine the affected side and stage.

B0043.title: Third Row Left Frontal Stage 3 Deployment Control
B0043.plain: Fault on third-row left frontal airbag, stage 3 deployment.

B0046.title: Left Curtain Deployment Loop Open
B0046.plain: An open circuit has been detected in the deployment loop of the left curtain (head) airbag. Curtain protection on the driver side will not deploy.

B0047.title: Left Curtain Deployment Loop Short to Ground
B0047.plain: The left curtain airbag deployment loop is shorted to ground; the SRS module inhibits deployment.

B0048.title: Third Row Right Side Airbag Deployment Control
B0048.plain: Fault on third-row right-side airbag deployment circuit.

B0049.title: Third Row Right Frontal Stage 1 Deployment Control
B0049.plain: Fault on third-row right frontal airbag, stage 1 deployment.

B004A.title: Third Row Right Frontal Stage 2 Deployment Control
B004A.plain: Fault on third-row right frontal airbag, stage 2 deployment.

B004B.title: Third Row Right Frontal Stage 3 Deployment Control
B004B.plain: Fault on third-row right frontal airbag, stage 3 deployment.

B0050.title: Driver Pretensioner Deployment Control
B0050.plain: Driver Pretensioner Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Pretensioner squib circuit open or shorted

B0051.title: Driver Frontal Deployment Control Open
B0051.plain: The SRS module has detected an open circuit in the driver frontal airbag deployment loop. Resistance is above the upper threshold, indicating broken wiring or a disconnected igniter.
causes: Wiring open between module and squib

B0052.title: Passenger Seat Belt Sensor
B0052.plain: Fault on the passenger seat belt buckle/tongue sensor that detects whether the belt is fastened.

B0053.title: Passenger Pretensioner Deployment Control
B0053.plain: Passenger Pretensioner Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Pretensioner squib circuit open or shorted

B0054.title: Second Row Center Seat Belt Sensor
B0054.plain: Fault on the second-row center seat belt buckle sensor.

B0055.title: Second Row Right Seat Belt Sensor
B0055.plain: Fault on the second-row right seat belt buckle sensor.

B0056.title: Right Curtain Deployment Loop Open
B0056.plain: The right curtain airbag deployment circuit shows an open condition; the curtain on the passenger side cannot deploy.

B0057.title: Right Curtain Deployment Loop Short to Ground
B0057.plain: The right curtain airbag deployment loop is shorted to ground.

B0058.title: Third Row Right Seat Belt Sensor
B0058.plain: Fault on the third-row right seat belt buckle sensor.

B0060.title: Knee Airbag Deployment Control
B0060.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the deployment control circuit of a knee airbag. Knee protection in a frontal collision may be reduced.

B0061.title: Knee Airbag Deployment Loop Open
B0061.plain: An open is detected in the knee airbag deployment loop.

B0062.title: Knee Airbag Deployment Loop Short to Ground
B0062.plain: The knee airbag deployment loop is shorted to ground.

B0064.title: Driver Seat Belt Tension Sensor
B0064.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the driver seat belt tension sensor. This sensor measures belt load and is used by adaptive restraint systems to scale airbag deployment force based on occupant size.

B0070.title: Vehicle Rollover Sensor
B0070.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the rollover sensor circuit. The rollover sensor triggers curtain airbags and seat belt pretensioners when the vehicle approaches a tip-over angle.

B0071.title: First Row Center Seat Belt Pretensioner Deployment Control
B0071.plain: Fault on the first-row center seat belt pretensioner deployment circuit. Pretensioners pull belt slack tight at the moment of impact.

B0072.title: Driver Seatbelt Pretensioner Loop Open
B0072.plain: The SRS module detects an open circuit in the driver seatbelt pretensioner deployment loop. The pretensioner cannot fire and the airbag warning lamp is on.

B0073.title: Driver Seatbelt Pretensioner Loop Short to Ground
B0073.plain: The driver seatbelt pretensioner deployment circuit is shorted to ground.

B0074.title: Driver Seatbelt Pretensioner Loop Short to Battery
B0074.plain: The driver seatbelt pretensioner deployment circuit is shorted to battery voltage, risking unintended firing.

B0075.title: Second Row Right Seat Belt Pretensioner Deployment Control
B0075.plain: Fault on the second-row right seat belt pretensioner deployment circuit.

B0076.title: Driver Seatbelt Pretensioner Resistance Low
B0076.plain: The pretensioner deployment loop resistance is below the expected window, suggesting a partial short.

B0077.title: Driver Seatbelt Pretensioner Resistance High
B0077.plain: The driver seatbelt pretensioner loop resistance is above the expected window. The pretensioner may not fire reliably.

B0078.title: Third Row Right Seat Belt Pretensioner Deployment Control
B0078.plain: Fault on the third-row right seat belt pretensioner deployment circuit.

B0079.title: Driver Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B0079.plain: Fault on the driver seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit. Pretensioner B is a secondary tightening stage on systems with multi-stage pretensioners.

B007A.title: Passenger Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B007A.plain: Fault on passenger seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B007B.title: Second Row Left Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B007B.plain: Fault on second-row left seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B007C.title: Second Row Right Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B007C.plain: Fault on second-row right seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B007D.title: Second Row Center Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B007D.plain: Fault on second-row center seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B007E.title: Driver Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B007E.plain: Fault on driver seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit. Pretensioner C is a third-stage tightener on systems with three-stage pretensioners.

B007F.title: Passenger Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B007F.plain: Fault on passenger seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B0080.title: Driver Seat Belt Load Limiter Deployment Control
B0080.plain: Fault on the driver seat belt load limiter deployment circuit. Load limiters release belt webbing under high force to limit chest loads after the pretensioner has tightened the belt.

B0081.title: Front Passenger Belt Switch Circuit
B0081.plain: The SRS or body control module has detected a fault in the front passenger seat belt buckle switch circuit. The switch reports whether the belt is fastened and is used for the belt warning lamp and for restraint logic.

B0082.title: Passenger Seatbelt Pretensioner Loop Open
B0082.plain: The passenger seatbelt pretensioner deployment loop is open; the pretensioner will not fire.

B0083.title: Passenger Seatbelt Pretensioner Loop Short to Ground
B0083.plain: The passenger pretensioner deployment circuit is shorted to ground.

B0084.title: Driver Belt Buckle Switch Circuit
B0084.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the driver belt buckle switch circuit. The fastened-state of the seat belt cannot be reliably read — affects belt warning and airbag deployment logic.

B0085.title: Passenger Belt Buckle Switch Circuit
B0085.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the passenger belt buckle switch circuit. Same fault profile as B0084 but for the passenger side.

B0086.title: Passenger Seatbelt Pretensioner Resistance Low
B0086.plain: The passenger seatbelt pretensioner loop has below-normal resistance, indicating a partial short.

B0087.title: Passenger Seatbelt Pretensioner Resistance High
B0087.plain: The passenger pretensioner loop resistance is too high, suggesting corroded contacts or partial breaks.

B0088.title: Third Row Right Seat Belt Load Limiter Deployment Control
B0088.plain: Fault on the third-row right seat belt load limiter deployment circuit.

B0090.title: Driver Side Pretensioner Stage 2 Deployment Control
B0090.plain: Driver Side Pretensioner Stage 2 Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

B0091.title: Passenger Side Pretensioner Stage 2 Deployment Control
B0091.plain: Passenger Side Pretensioner Stage 2 Deployment Control: the restraints module has detected a fault in this airbag/pretensioner deployment circuit, which may prevent correct deployment in a crash. Safety-critical.
causes: Stage 2 squib circuit open or shorted

B0092.title: Side Impact Sensor Left Front Malfunction
B0092.plain: The SRS module reports that the left front side impact sensor is malfunctioning. Side airbag deployment may not occur correctly in a side crash.

B0093.title: Side Impact Sensor Left Front Communication Lost
B0093.plain: The SRS module has lost communication with the left front side impact sensor over the dedicated bus.
causes: Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly

B0094.title: Side Impact Sensor Right Front Malfunction
B0094.plain: The right front side impact sensor reports a malfunction or fails plausibility checks against the SRS module.

B0095.title: Occupant Classification System Performance
B0095.plain: The SRS module reports that the occupant classification system (OCS) on the passenger seat does not behave plausibly. The OCS detects whether the seat is empty, occupied by a small person, or by an adult — and adapts airbag deployment accordingly.
causes: OCS sensor mat aged or damaged

B0096.title: Side Impact Sensor Left Rear Malfunction
B0096.plain: The left rear side impact sensor is reporting a fault.

B0097.title: Side Impact Sensor Right Rear Malfunction
B0097.plain: The right rear side impact sensor is reporting a malfunction or implausible signal.

B0098.title: Occupant Detection Sensor
B0098.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the occupant detection sensor on the passenger seat. The sensor input is missing or out of range so passenger airbag enable/disable logic cannot be evaluated.
causes: Seat harness connector under passenger seat damaged

B0099.title: Occupant Detection Module Internal Fault
B0099.plain: The occupant detection module reports an internal fault detected by self-test. The module typically processes seat sensor data and reports occupancy status to the SRS module.
causes: Power supply or ground fault to module

B009A.title: Left Side Restraints Sensor 4
B009A.plain: Fault on left-side restraints sensor 4. Side impact sensors detect lateral acceleration to trigger side and curtain airbags.

B00A0.title: Occupant Classification System
B00A0.plain: Fault on the occupant classification system (OCS) — typically detects whether the front passenger seat is empty, holds a child seat, or has an adult, to enable/suppress passenger airbag.

B00A1.title: Occupant Position System
B00A1.plain: Fault on the occupant position system that detects forward/rearward position of occupants, used by the airbag controller to scale deployment force.

B00B0.title: Driver Seat Occupant Classification Sensor A
B00B0.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant classification sensor A — typically a force/weight sensing pad in the seat cushion that determines passenger weight class.

B00B1.title: Driver Seat Occupant Classification Sensor B
B00B1.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant classification sensor B.

B00B2.title: Driver Seat Occupant Classification Sensor C
B00B2.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant classification sensor C.

B00B3.title: Driver Seat Occupant Classification Sensor D
B00B3.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant classification sensor D.

B00B4.title: Driver Seat Occupant Classification Sensor E
B00B4.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant classification sensor E.

B00B5.title: Driver Seat Track Position Restraints Sensor
B00B5.plain: Fault on the driver seat track position sensor — detects fore/aft seat position, used by the airbag controller to adapt deployment to seat distance from steering wheel.

B00B6.title: Driver Seat Recline Position Restraints Sensor
B00B6.plain: Fault on the driver seat recline position sensor — detects backrest angle, used by the airbag controller for deployment scaling.

B00B7.title: Driver Seat Occupant Position Sensor A
B00B7.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant position sensor A — detects occupant proximity to airbag (typically capacitive or ultrasonic).

B00B8.title: Driver Seat Occupant Position Sensor B
B00B8.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant position sensor B.

B00B9.title: Driver Seat Occupant Position Sensor C
B00B9.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant position sensor C.

B00BA.title: Driver Seat Occupant Position Sensor D
B00BA.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant position sensor D.

B00BB.title: Driver Seat Occupant Position Sensor E
B00BB.plain: Fault on driver seat occupant position sensor E.

B00C0.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Classification Sensor A
B00C0.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant classification sensor A — used to determine if the seat holds a child, adult or is empty (gates the passenger airbag).

B00C1.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Classification Sensor B
B00C1.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant classification sensor B.

B00C2.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Classification Sensor C
B00C2.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant classification sensor C.

B00C3.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Classification Sensor D
B00C3.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant classification sensor D.

B00C4.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Classification Sensor E
B00C4.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant classification sensor E.

B00C5.title: Passenger Seat Track Position Restraints Sensor
B00C5.plain: Fault on the passenger seat track position sensor.

B00C6.title: Passenger Seat Recline Position Restraints Sensor
B00C6.plain: Fault on the passenger seat recline position sensor.

B00C7.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Position Sensor A
B00C7.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant position sensor A.

B00C8.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Position Sensor B
B00C8.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant position sensor B.

B00C9.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Position Sensor C
B00C9.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant position sensor C.

B00CA.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Position Sensor D
B00CA.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant position sensor D.

B00CB.title: Passenger Seat Occupant Position Sensor E
B00CB.plain: Fault on passenger seat occupant position sensor E.

B00D0.title: Driver Seat Belt Indicator
B00D0.plain: Fault on the driver seat belt warning indicator (lamp/icon in cluster).

B00D1.title: Passenger Seat Belt Indicator
B00D1.plain: Fault on the passenger seat belt warning indicator.

B00D2.title: Restraint System Malfunction Indicator 1
B00D2.plain: Fault on the SRS (airbag) malfunction warning indicator 1 — usually the airbag warning lamp in the cluster.

B00D3.title: Restraint System Malfunction Indicator 2
B00D3.plain: Fault on SRS malfunction warning indicator 2 (secondary indicator).

B00D4.title: Restraint System Malfunction Audible Indicator
B00D4.plain: Fault on the audible warning (chime) for SRS malfunction.

B00D5.title: Restraint System Passenger Disable Indicator
B00D5.plain: Fault on the indicator that shows the passenger airbag is disabled (typically a "PASSENGER AIRBAG OFF" lamp).

B00DF.title: Passenger Restraints Disable Switch
B00DF.plain: Fault on the key-operated switch that manually disables the passenger airbag (typically used when fitting a rear-facing child seat).

B00E0.title: Third Row Left Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B00E0.plain: Fault on third-row left seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B00E1.title: Third Row Right Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B00E1.plain: Fault on third-row right seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B00E2.title: Third Row Center Seat Belt Pretensioner B Deployment Control
B00E2.plain: Fault on third-row center seat belt pretensioner B deployment circuit.

B00E3.title: Second Row Left Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B00E3.plain: Fault on second-row left seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B00E4.title: Second Row Right Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B00E4.plain: Fault on second-row right seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B00E5.title: Second Row Center Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B00E5.plain: Fault on second-row center seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B00E6.title: Third Row Right Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B00E6.plain: Fault on third-row right seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B00E7.title: Third Row Left Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B00E7.plain: Fault on third-row left seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B00E8.title: Third Row Center Seat Belt Pretensioner C Deployment Control
B00E8.plain: Fault on third-row center seat belt pretensioner C deployment circuit.

B00F0.title: Driver Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F0.plain: Fault on the deployment circuit of the driver inflatable seat belt. Inflatable belts (e.g. Ford rear-seat system) widen the belt webbing on impact to spread crash loads over a larger area.

B00F1.title: Passenger Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F1.plain: Fault on the passenger inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B00F2.title: Second Row Left Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F2.plain: Fault on second-row left inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B00F3.title: Second Row Center Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F3.plain: Fault on second-row center inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B00F4.title: Second Row Right Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F4.plain: Fault on second-row right inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B00F5.title: Third Row Left Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F5.plain: Fault on third-row left inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B00F6.title: Third Row Center Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F6.plain: Fault on third-row center inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B00F7.title: Third Row Right Inflatable Seat Belt Deployment Control
B00F7.plain: Fault on third-row right inflatable seat belt deployment circuit.

B0100.title: Driver Door Lock Cylinder Switch Circuit
B0100.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver door lock cylinder switch circuit. This switch detects key rotation in the door lock and is used for keyless functions and the alarm system.
causes: Door harness broken in door hinge area

B0101.title: Front Crash Sensor Circuit Malfunction
B0101.plain: A fault has been detected in the front crash sensor circuit, used to detect frontal impacts and trigger airbags/pretensioners.

B0102.title: Power Mirror Switch Circuit
B0102.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the power mirror switch circuit. The switch input does not match a valid pattern — mirror adjustment may be inoperative.

B0103.title: Front Crash Sensor Left Communication Lost
B0103.plain: Communication with the left front crash sensor has been lost; SRS deployment logic for frontal impacts is degraded.
causes: Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly
CAN terminating resistor (120 Ω) drifted out of spec

B0104.title: Driver Mirror Adjust Switch Circuit
B0104.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver-side mirror adjust switch circuit. The mirror cannot be moved via the switch on the driver door.

B0105.title: Front Crash Sensor Right Communication Lost
B0105.plain: Communication with the right front crash sensor has been lost.
causes: Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly
CAN terminating resistor (120 Ω) drifted out of spec

B0106.title: Passenger Mirror Adjust Switch Circuit
B0106.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger-side mirror adjust switch circuit. Same fault profile as B0104 but for the passenger mirror.

B0107.title: Rollover Sensor Malfunction
B0107.plain: The rollover sensor used to deploy curtain airbags or trigger fuel cutoff in a rollover event has failed plausibility checks.

B0108.title: Mirror Folder Switch Circuit
B0108.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the mirror folder switch circuit. Power-folding mirrors cannot be folded or unfolded via the switch.

B0109.title: LIDAR Washer Actuator D
B0109.plain: Fault on LIDAR washer actuator D — sprays cleaning fluid onto the LIDAR sensor lens to keep it free of dirt, snow or insects.

B010A.title: Camera Washer Actuator A
B010A.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator A — sprays fluid on a camera lens (front camera, surround-view, etc.) to keep ADAS vision systems clear.

B010B.title: Camera Washer Actuator B
B010B.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator B. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B010C.title: Camera Washer Actuator C
B010C.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator C. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B010D.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator D. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B010E.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator E. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B010F.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator F. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0110.title: Driver Pelvic/Thorax Airbag Deployment Control
B0110.plain: The SRS module has detected a deployment control fault for the driver pelvic/thorax airbag commonly integrated into the seat backrest.

B0111.title: Camera Washer Actuator H
B0111.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator H. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0114.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator L. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0115.title: Camera Washer Actuator M
B0115.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator M. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0116.title: Camera Washer Actuator N
B0116.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator N. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0117.title: Camera Washer Actuator O
B0117.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator O. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0118.title: Camera Washer Actuator P
B0118.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator P. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B0119.title: Camera Washer Actuator Q
B0119.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator Q. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B011A.title: Camera Washer Actuator R
B011A.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator R. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B011B.title: Camera Washer Actuator S
B011B.plain: Fault on camera washer actuator S. The cam phaser actuator adjusts intake/exhaust timing under load — a stuck or slow phaser kills mid-rpm torque and can throw correlation codes between cam and crank.

B011C.title: Fluid Reservoir Level Sensor A
B011C.plain: Fault on fluid reservoir level sensor A. Tracks fluid level in a wash, brake or coolant reservoir.

B011D.title: Fluid Reservoir Level Sensor B
B011D.plain: Fault on fluid reservoir level sensor B.

B011E.title: Fluid Reservoir Level Sensor C
B011E.plain: Fault on fluid reservoir level sensor C.

B011F.title: Fluid Reservoir Level Sensor D
B011F.plain: Fault on fluid reservoir level sensor D.

B0120.title: Passenger Pelvic/Thorax Airbag Deployment Control
B0120.plain: The SRS module has detected a deployment control fault for the passenger pelvic/thorax airbag.

B0121.title: Fluid Reservoir Level Sensor F
B0121.plain: Fault on fluid reservoir level sensor F.

B0122.title: Pedestrian Alert Speaker A
B0122.plain: Fault on pedestrian alert speaker A — emits an artificial driving sound at low speed on EVs/hybrids (legally required, e.g. UNECE R138, FMVSS 141).

B0123.title: Pedestrian Alert Speaker B
B0123.plain: Fault on pedestrian alert speaker B (second/redundant speaker).

B0124.title: Night Vision Camera
B0124.plain: Fault on the night vision camera (typically a thermal/far-infrared camera that detects pedestrians and animals beyond headlight range).

B0125.title: Driver Side Mirror Position Sensor
B0125.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver-side mirror position sensor. Memory mirror positions cannot be saved or restored reliably.

B0126.title: Passenger Side Mirror Position Sensor
B0126.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger-side mirror position sensor. Same fault profile as B0125 but for the passenger mirror.

B0127.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet "A" Circuit/Open
B0127.plain: Open circuit on the high-voltage power outlet "A" of DC/AC converter A. The outlet supplies 110/230 V AC from the HV battery on EVs/hybrids (vehicle-to-load).
causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

B0128.title: Passenger Occupant Detection System Malfunction
B0128.plain: The passenger occupant detection system (ODS), used to enable/disable the passenger airbag based on weight, has reported a malfunction.
causes: ODS calibration lost after seat work

B0129.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet "C" Circuit/Open
B0129.plain: Open circuit on the high-voltage power outlet "C" of DC/AC converter A.
causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

B012A.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet "D" Circuit/Open
B012A.plain: Open circuit on the high-voltage power outlet "D" of DC/AC converter A.
causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

B012B.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet "E" Circuit/Open
B012B.plain: Open circuit on the high-voltage power outlet "E" of DC/AC converter A.
causes: Pin pushed back out of connector body
Cracked solder joint inside the module or sensor

B012C.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet Control Module "A"
B012C.plain: Fault reported by control module "A" of the high-voltage power outlet on DC/AC converter A.

B012D.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet Control Module "B"

B012E.title: DC/AC Converter A High Voltage Power Outlet Control Module "C"

B012F.title: A/V Sensor Washer Fluid A Control Circuit
B012F.plain: Fault on the control circuit of the audio/video sensor washer fluid pump A. Sprays cleaning fluid on ADAS audio/video sensor lenses.

B0130.title: Driver Seatbelt Tension Sensor Circuit
B0130.plain: The driver seatbelt tension sensor circuit is faulty. This sensor is used by the SRS to adjust deployment based on belt usage.

B0131.title: A/V Sensor Washer Fluid C Control Circuit
B0131.plain: Fault on the audio/video sensor washer fluid pump C control circuit.

B0132.title: A/V Sensor Washer Fluid D Control Circuit
B0132.plain: Fault on the A/V sensor washer fluid pump D control circuit.

B0133.title: A/V Sensor Washer Fluid E Control Circuit
B0133.plain: Fault on the A/V sensor washer fluid pump E control circuit.

B0134.title: A/V Sensor Washer Fluid F Control Circuit
B0134.plain: Fault on the A/V sensor washer fluid pump F control circuit.

B0140.title: Passenger Seatbelt Tension Sensor Circuit
B0140.plain: The passenger seatbelt tension sensor circuit is faulty.

B0150.title: HVAC Mode Door Range/Performance
B0150.plain: The HVAC control module has detected that the air distribution mode door (e.g. floor/face/defrost) does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The actuator may be stuck, the door binding, or the position feedback inaccurate.
causes: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

B0152.title: Driver Buckle Switch Circuit Malfunction
B0152.plain: The driver seatbelt buckle switch circuit, used to detect whether the belt is fastened, is malfunctioning. The seatbelt warning may be permanently on or off.

B0154.title: Passenger Buckle Switch Circuit Malfunction
B0154.plain: The passenger seatbelt buckle switch circuit is malfunctioning.

B0156.title: Sun Load Sensor Circuit
B0156.plain: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the sun load (solar) sensor, typically located on the dashboard. Automatic climate control uses this signal to bias cooling on the side facing the sun.

B0158.title: Ambient Air Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0158.plain: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the ambient air temperature sensor used by the climate control system. Symptoms include incorrect outside temperature display and erratic automatic climate behavior.

B0159.title: Outside Temperature Sensor Range/Performance
B0159.plain: The HVAC control module reports an out-of-range or implausible reading from the outside air temperature sensor. The displayed value may be stuck or impossibly high/low.
causes: Sensor element aged beyond calibration window

B0160.title: In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0160.plain: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the in-vehicle temperature sensor — typically an aspirated sensor in the dashboard. Automatic climate control regulates cabin temperature using this signal.

B0162.title: Sun Load Sensor 2 Circuit
B0162.plain: The HVAC control module has detected an implausible signal from the second sun load sensor. Dual-zone systems use two solar sensors to detect side-asymmetric sunlight and adjust left/right airflow temperature.

B0164.title: Air Bag In-Vehicle Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0164.plain: A fault is detected in the in-vehicle temperature sensor circuit used by the SRS module for deployment compensation.

B0166.title: HVAC Discharge Air Temperature Sensor
B0166.plain: The HVAC control module reports an implausible signal from the discharge (vent outlet) air temperature sensor. This sensor verifies that the actual outlet air temperature matches the commanded value.

B0168.title: HVAC Air Mix Door Performance
B0168.plain: The HVAC control module has detected that the air mix (blend) door does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The blend door regulates the ratio of air through the heater core versus around it.
causes: Blend door mechanically binding or broken

B0170.title: HVAC Mode Door Position Sensor
B0170.plain: The HVAC control module reports an implausible position signal from the mode (air distribution) door feedback sensor. Without valid feedback the actuator cannot be regulated to the correct position.
causes: Wiring or connector fault to actuator

B0173.title: HVAC Air Inlet Door
B0173.plain: The HVAC control module has detected a fault on the fresh-air/recirculation inlet door — typically a stuck actuator or position feedback out of range.

B0175.title: HVAC Recirculation Door Performance
B0175.plain: The HVAC control module has detected that the recirculation door does not reach the commanded position within the expected time. The recirc door switches between fresh air and recirculated cabin air.

B0181.title: Front Blower Motor Circuit Low
B0181.plain: The HVAC control module has detected low voltage or a short to ground in the front blower motor circuit. The blower may run too slow or not at all.
causes: Blower resistor or power module failed

B0182.title: Right Front/Passenger Side Buckle Tension Sensor Circuit
B0182.plain: The right front buckle tension sensor circuit is reporting a malfunction.

B0184.title: Rear Blower Motor Circuit
B0184.plain: The HVAC control module has detected a fault in the rear blower motor circuit, used in vehicles with separate rear climate zones. Symptoms include no rear airflow or rear blower stuck on.

B0186.title: Front Blower Motor Speed Performance
B0186.plain: The HVAC control module has detected that the front blower motor does not run at the commanded speed. Possible causes include a worn motor, blocked airway, or driver module fault.

B0188.title: Rear Wiper Motor Circuit
B0188.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear wiper motor circuit. Possible faults include an open or shorted motor winding, a stuck mechanism, or wiring damage in the tailgate harness.

B0190.title: Front Wiper Park Switch Circuit
B0190.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the front wiper park switch circuit. The wipers may not return to the park position when switched off.
causes: Park switch in wiper motor failed

B0192.title: Front Wiper Speed Performance
B0192.plain: The body control module has detected that the front wiper does not run at the commanded speed. Possible causes include a worn motor, binding linkage, or excessive load.

B0200.title: Air Bag System Voltage Out of Range
B0200.plain: The SRS module has detected that its supply voltage is outside the operating range, preventing reliable deployment readiness.

B0205.title: HVAC Defroster Door Position
B0205.plain: The HVAC control module has detected that the defroster door (windshield air outlet flap) does not reach the commanded position. Defrosting performance may be reduced.
causes: Door actuator motor failed or stripped

B0210.title: Rain Sensor Module
B0210.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the rain sensor module on the windshield. Automatic wiper activation based on moisture detection is no longer available.

B0220.title: Front Wiper Motor Speed Circuit
B0220.plain: The body control module has detected that the front wiper motor speed feedback does not match the commanded speed. The motor may run only on one speed or not at all.

B0223.title: SRS Indicator Lamp Circuit Malfunction
B0223.plain: The SRS module has detected a fault in the airbag warning lamp circuit. The lamp may be inoperative, which prevents driver notification of stored faults.

B0226.title: Headlamp Auto-Leveling Front Sensor
B0226.plain: The body control module reports an implausible signal from the front ride-height sensor used by the automatic headlamp leveling system. Without valid input, the headlamp pitch cannot be corrected for vehicle load.

B0228.title: Front Fog Lamp Circuit
B0228.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the front fog lamp circuit — typically an open bulb, blown fuse, or wiring fault. One or both fog lamps may not work.

B0231.title: Front Marker Lamp Circuit
B0231.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the front side marker lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — the bulb may be burned out or the wiring is open.

B0233.title: Rear Tail Lamp Circuit
B0233.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear tail lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.

B0235.title: Brake Lamp Circuit
B0235.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the brake lamp circuit. One or more brake lamps do not match the commanded state — a safety-relevant fault.

B0237.title: Backup Lamp Circuit
B0237.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the backup (reverse) lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state when reverse gear is engaged.

B0239.title: License Plate Lamp Circuit
B0239.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the license plate lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.

B0240.title: Headlamp Switch Circuit
B0240.plain: The body control module has detected an implausible state at the headlamp switch — for example simultaneous low and high beam request, or no signal at all. Lighting functions may be erratic.

B0245.title: Driver Window Switch Circuit
B0245.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver window switch circuit. The window may not respond to the switch in the driver door.

B0247.title: Passenger Window Switch Circuit
B0247.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger window switch circuit. Same fault profile as B0245 but for the passenger window.

B0250.title: HVAC Air Temperature Internal Sensor Circuit
B0250.plain: The HVAC controller has detected a fault in the internal cabin air temperature sensor circuit, used to regulate climate control output.

B0252.title: Driver Window Motor Down Circuit
B0252.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver window motor down-direction control circuit. The window may not lower correctly.

B0255.title: HVAC Air Temperature External Sensor Circuit
B0255.plain: A fault has been detected in the external (ambient) temperature sensor circuit used by the HVAC and instrument cluster.
causes: Ambient sensor failure (often behind front grille)

B0258.title: HVAC Air Mix Door 1 Circuit
B0258.plain: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the actuator circuit for air mix door 1, which controls the proportion of warm and cool air in the airflow.
causes: Air mix door actuator motor failed

B0260.title: Interior Light Circuit
B0260.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the interior light circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — common cause is a stuck door switch causing battery drain.

B0263.title: HVAC Air Mix Door 2 Circuit
B0263.plain: A fault has been detected in the air mix door 2 actuator circuit, used in dual-zone HVAC systems for the passenger side.

B0265.title: Driver Door Lock/Unlock Switch Circuit
B0265.plain: Driver Door Lock/Unlock Switch Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects central locking operated from this switch.
causes: Door harness broken in hinge area

B0268.title: HVAC Mode Door 1 Circuit
B0268.plain: The HVAC mode door 1 actuator circuit, which routes airflow between defrost, vents, and floor, has reported a fault.

B0270.title: Passenger Door Lock Switch Circuit
B0270.plain: Passenger Door Lock Switch Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects central locking operated from this switch.
causes: Door harness broken in hinge area

B0272.title: Power Door Lock Switch Circuit
B0272.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the power door lock switch circuit. Central locking may not respond to the door switch.

B0273.title: HVAC Recirculation Door Circuit
B0273.plain: The HVAC recirculation door actuator circuit has reported a fault. Fresh/recirculated air switching may not work.

B0274.title: Trunk Lid Release Switch Circuit
B0274.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the trunk lid release switch circuit. The trunk may not open via the interior or remote release.

B0278.title: HVAC Defrost Door Circuit
B0278.plain: A fault is detected in the HVAC defrost door actuator circuit; defrost airflow may not engage.

B0283.title: HVAC Blower Motor Circuit
B0283.plain: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the blower motor control circuit. Blower may run at incorrect speed or not at all.
causes: Blower resistor or final stage failed

B0288.title: HVAC A/C Pressure Sensor Circuit
B0288.plain: A fault has been detected in the A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. The compressor may be disabled to protect the system.

B0290.title: Rear Defrost Switch Circuit
B0290.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear window defroster switch circuit. The switch may be stuck or its signal does not reach the module — the rear defroster cannot be activated.

B0292.title: HVAC A/C Compressor Clutch Circuit
B0292.plain: The HVAC controller has detected a fault in the A/C compressor clutch control circuit. The compressor may not engage.

B0300.title: HVAC Evaporator Temperature Sensor Circuit
B0300.plain: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the evaporator temperature sensor circuit, used to prevent evaporator icing.

B0305.title: HVAC Sun Load Sensor Circuit
B0305.plain: A fault has been detected in the sun load sensor circuit used by automatic climate control to compensate for solar gain.

B0310.title: Driver Seat Position Sensor Circuit
B0310.plain: Driver Seat Position Sensor Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. The sensor reports seat position for the memory function and SRS occupant logic.

B0312.title: Driver Seat Forward/Back Switch Circuit
B0312.plain: The seat module has detected a fault in the fore/aft adjustment switch on the driver seat. Manual adjustment of the seat position may be limited or not work at all.

B0320.title: Passenger Seat Position Sensor Circuit
B0320.plain: Passenger Seat Position Sensor Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. The sensor reports seat position for the memory function and SRS occupant logic.

B0322.title: Driver Seat Tilt Position Sensor
B0322.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat tilt position sensor. Memory positions for seat back tilt cannot be reliably stored.

B0325.title: Driver Seat Memory Set Switch
B0325.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat memory set switch circuit. Seat positions cannot be saved to memory presets.
causes: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

B0327.title: Passenger Seat Position Memory
B0327.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger seat position memory function. Saved positions cannot be reliably restored.
causes: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

B0330.title: HVAC Rear Blower Motor Circuit
B0330.plain: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the rear blower motor circuit, used in vehicles with rear climate zone.

B0335.title: Driver Seat Heater Circuit
B0335.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver seat heater circuit. The heating element or wiring is open or shorted — the seat does not heat.

B0337.title: Passenger Seat Heater Circuit
B0337.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger seat heater circuit. Same fault profile as B0335 but for the passenger seat.

B0339.title: Rear Seat Heater Circuit
B0339.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear seat heater circuit. The rear heating elements are open or shorted.

B0341.title: HVAC Heated Seat Driver Circuit
B0341.plain: A fault has been detected in the driver heated seat circuit. Seat heating may be disabled.

B0342.title: HVAC Heated Seat Passenger Circuit
B0342.plain: A fault has been detected in the passenger heated seat circuit.

B0420.title: Audio System Internal Failure
B0420.plain: The audio head unit reports an internal self-test failure. Symptoms include silent output, frozen display, or repeated reboots of the infotainment system.

B0425.title: Audio Amplifier Internal Failure
B0425.plain: The audio amplifier reports an internal self-test failure. Sound output may be distorted, missing on some channels, or the amplifier enters a protection mode.

B0440.title: Bluetooth Module Fault
B0440.plain: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the Bluetooth module. Pairing with phones may fail or audio streaming drops out.

B0445.title: USB Hub Fault
B0445.plain: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the internal USB hub. USB ports may not detect connected devices reliably.

B0450.title: Microphone Circuit
B0450.plain: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the hands-free microphone circuit. Voice commands and phone calls may have poor audio quality.

B0455.title: Display Module Internal Failure
B0455.plain: The instrument cluster or central display module reports an internal self-test failure. Pixels may be missing, the screen may stay dark, or warning indicators may not display correctly.

B0460.title: Bluetooth Antenna Circuit
B0460.plain: The infotainment system has detected a fault in the Bluetooth antenna circuit. Range and connection stability may be reduced.

B0490.title: Display Backlight Circuit
B0490.plain: The infotainment or instrument cluster module has detected a fault in the display backlight circuit. The display may stay dark or be unreadable in low light.

B0500.title: Driver Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0500.plain: The driver power window motor or switch circuit has reported a fault. The window may not operate.

B0501.title: Passenger Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0501.plain: A fault has been detected in the passenger power window circuit.

B0502.title: Left Rear Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0502.plain: A fault has been detected in the left rear power window circuit.

B0503.title: Right Rear Power Window Circuit Malfunction
B0503.plain: A fault has been detected in the right rear power window circuit.

B0510.title: Driver Door Open Switch
B0510.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver door open (jamb) switch. The door open state cannot be reliably read — affects interior light, seat belt warning, and remote start interlocks.
causes: Door jamb switch stuck or corroded

B0520.title: Passenger Door Open Switch
B0520.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger door open (jamb) switch. Same fault profile as B0510 but for the passenger door.
causes: Door jamb switch stuck or corroded

B0530.title: Driver Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0530.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver door lock actuator circuit. Central locking may not work for the driver door.

B0531.title: Passenger Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0531.plain: A fault has been detected in the passenger door lock actuator circuit.

B0532.title: Left Rear Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0532.plain: A fault has been detected in the left rear door lock actuator circuit.

B0533.title: Right Rear Door Lock Actuator Circuit
B0533.plain: A fault has been detected in the right rear door lock actuator circuit.

B0540.title: Driver Door Ajar Switch Circuit
B0540.plain: The driver door ajar switch circuit is reporting an implausible signal. The interior light may stay on or door open warning may be incorrect.

B0541.title: Passenger Door Ajar Switch Circuit
B0541.plain: The passenger door ajar switch circuit is malfunctioning.

B0560.title: Driver Power Seat Forward/Back Circuit
B0560.plain: A fault is detected in the forward/back motor circuit of the driver power seat.

B0561.title: Driver Power Seat Up/Down Circuit
B0561.plain: A fault is detected in the up/down motor circuit of the driver power seat.

B0562.title: Driver Power Seat Recline Circuit
B0562.plain: A fault is detected in the recline motor circuit of the driver power seat.

B0570.title: Passenger Power Seat Forward/Back Circuit
B0570.plain: A fault is detected in the forward/back motor circuit of the passenger power seat.

B0580.title: Driver Seat Memory Module Malfunction
B0580.plain: The driver seat memory module reports an internal fault. Stored seat positions cannot be recalled.
causes: Module software outdated, reflash may resolve

B0600.title: Mirror Adjustment Driver Side Circuit
B0600.plain: The driver side mirror adjustment circuit is malfunctioning. Mirror motor or position sensor fault.

B0601.title: Mirror Adjustment Passenger Side Circuit
B0601.plain: The passenger side mirror adjustment circuit is malfunctioning.

B0610.title: Mirror Heater Circuit
B0610.plain: A fault has been detected in the heated mirror circuit. Mirrors will not defog.

B0700.title: Sunroof Open/Close Circuit
B0700.plain: A fault has been detected in the sunroof open/close motor circuit.

B0710.title: Sunroof Position Sensor Circuit
B0710.plain: A fault is detected in the sunroof position sensor circuit; one-touch and pinch protection may not function.

B0800.title: Headlamp Switch Circuit
B0800.plain: A fault has been detected in the headlamp switch circuit. Light functions may not switch properly.

B0810.title: Left Headlamp Low Beam Circuit
B0810.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the left low beam headlamp circuit. Bulb may be burnt out or wiring shorted.

B0811.title: Right Headlamp Low Beam Circuit
B0811.plain: The body control module has detected a fault in the right low beam headlamp circuit.

B0820.title: Left Headlamp High Beam Circuit
B0820.plain: A fault has been detected in the left high beam headlamp circuit.

B0821.title: Right Headlamp High Beam Circuit
B0821.plain: A fault has been detected in the right high beam headlamp circuit.

B0830.title: Left Front Turn Signal Circuit
B0830.plain: A fault has been detected in the left front turn signal circuit.

B0831.title: Right Front Turn Signal Circuit
B0831.plain: A fault has been detected in the right front turn signal circuit.

B0840.title: Left Rear Turn Signal Circuit
B0840.plain: A fault has been detected in the left rear turn signal circuit.

B0841.title: Right Rear Turn Signal Circuit
B0841.plain: A fault has been detected in the right rear turn signal circuit.

B0850.title: Left Brake Lamp Circuit
B0850.plain: A fault has been detected in the left brake lamp circuit.

B0851.title: Right Brake Lamp Circuit
B0851.plain: A fault has been detected in the right brake lamp circuit.

B0860.title: License Plate Lamp Circuit
B0860.plain: A fault has been detected in the license plate lamp circuit.

B0900.title: Wiper Motor Front Circuit
B0900.plain: A fault has been detected in the front wiper motor circuit.

B0910.title: Wiper Motor Rear Circuit
B0910.plain: A fault has been detected in the rear wiper motor circuit.

B0920.title: Washer Pump Circuit
B0920.plain: A fault has been detected in the windshield washer pump circuit.

B0950.title: Heated Rear Window Circuit
B0950.plain: A fault has been detected in the heated rear window circuit. Defrost may not function.

B0960.title: Horn Relay Circuit
B0960.plain: A fault has been detected in the horn relay control circuit.

B0970.title: Interior Light Circuit
B0970.plain: A fault has been detected in the interior light circuit.

B0980.title: Ignition Switch Run/Start Position Circuit
B0980.plain: The body control module reports an implausible signal from the ignition switch run/start position circuit.
causes: Open wire from switch to BCM

B0990.title: Body Control Module Internal Fault
B0990.plain: The body control module (BCM) has detected an internal fault and may need to be replaced.
